artworks.title: The Letter (Reflexion, ou la lettre)
artworks.artist: Norbert Goeneutte
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated in a slightly reclined position facing right. Her head is turned toward the viewer, holding a pencil to her chin. She has delicate facial features with a composed expression, neat hair partially covered by an elaborate hat, and wears a high-collared, long-sleeved dress with a voluminous skirt. She sits at a desk with papers. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain, highlighting the woman as the central subject.

artworks.title: Soldiers in a Windy Landscape
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Le Paon
artworks.medium: black chalk and pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a caravan of people and animals traveling along a winding path. The horizon shows distant hills and a line of trees. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing motion and patterns. The color palette includes soft grays, browns, and light tints. Large trees bend in the wind on the sides. Figures on horseback and foot lead the way with dogs. Wagons and more figures extend into the distance, showing continuous movement.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.artist: Alessandro Maganza
artworks.medium: leadpoint or graphite and pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an encounter between two figures. One figure is gesturing upwards and the other is leaning back in surprise. The drawing is composed of loose, expressive lines that depict a dynamic interaction between the two figures. The figure on the left has an outstretched arm and is surrounded by flowing lines. The figure on the right appears to be seated or leaning back, showing surprise or contemplation. The style is sketchy and captures a moment of interaction and emotion.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child Seated before a Ledge
artworks.artist: Thierry Bellange
artworks.medium: black and red chalk with graphite and gold on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with a child in her lap. The woman is facing slightly left, embracing the child. She has angular facial features, dark hair partially covered by a veil, and a gentle expression. The child has curly hair and is nestled close to the woman's chest. The woman is wearing a red and gray robe, sandals, and both have halos. The child is nude with a subtle halo. They sit on a stone bench in a classical setting with a distant horizon, clouds, and flying birds in the background. A richly ornamented vase of flowers is on the right, and a small bird is on the left of the bench.

artworks.title: A Man and Two Women on a Rocky Shore
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Le Prince
artworks.medium: graphite on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicolas Schwed
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures. The central figure is a man in 18th-century fashion, standing with his arms slightly extended. A woman reclines beside him, wearing a wide-brimmed hat. Another figure sits next to her. In the background, there is a person behind a table and a small sailboat in the water. A dog stands near the man. The setting includes trees and rocks, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Virgin, Queen of Heaven
artworks.artist: Circle of Francesco Vanni
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: This is a drawing of angels and figures among clouds. The image depicts numerous angelic figures and other characters amidst a cloud-filled environment. The composition is centered around a prominent figure surrounded by a radiant glow, with groups of figures in contemplative and lively interactions. The intricate detailing shows a vast congregation gathered in tiers of clouds enveloping the scene. The drawing technique emphasizes fluidity and movement.

artworks.title: Landscape with Travelers
artworks.artist: Johann Albrecht Dietzsch
artworks.medium: wash with pen and ink over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with several figures gathered in a landscape. A couple is seated on grass with a dog nearby. A large tree on the left partially frames the scene, with a fence meandering alongside it. The background shows undulating hills and trees fading into a misty sky. The color palette is sepia and grey.

artworks.title: Standing Musician
artworks.artist: Circle of Mariano Fortuny Marsal
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with gum arabic on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a man holding a string instrument, dressed in historical attire with a dark hat, vest, white shirt, red sash, dark trousers, striped socks, and dark shoes. The background is a textured, neutral-toned wash.

artworks.title: Adoration of the Magi
artworks.artist: Giovanni David, after Battista Dossi
artworks.medium: etching with bitten tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people. A seated woman is holding a child in her arms. In front of her, an elderly man is kneeling and presenting a round object. Other individuals surround them, with one man gesturing to the right. In the background, there are hills, bare trees, and roman-like architectural elements. The text "Et procidentes adoraverunt eum" is inscribed at the bottom.

Their facial features appear delicately rendered with smooth lines, a straight nose, and a composed expression. The hair is dark and curly, peeking from beneath a large, wrapped headscarf adorned with folds and rosettes. The clothing consists of a voluminous garment draped across the shoulders and covering part of the neck. No jewelry is visible, and the person is not holding any objects. The background is a circular area rendered in a dark tone, contrasting with the lighter figure. The artwork is enclosed in an oval frame on a textured paper, with some text printed beneath it.
